prospective_checkpoint_selection.rule: Use the completed checkpoint whose preserved seven-scene direct gate has the smallest absolute LEFT/RIGHT success gap; ties break by the frozen Phase-A model order.

known_direct_gate.scope: preserved V2 r0 coverage layer; descriptive checkpoint-selection evidence only

exact_prompts.left: Put the small woodenblock to the left of the red playingcards box.
exact_prompts.right: Put the small woodenblock to the right of the red playingcards box.

design.pairing: For each seed, all four arm-by-direction cells begin from hash-identical arm-specific resets; only the registered center-position reflection and prompt direction differ.
held_fixed: robot base, cameras, object orientations, and all nonmovable geometry
FastWAM checkpoint/runtime identity and action-only test interface
RoboTwin relation-aware success predicate, controller, and action cap
environment and sampling seed within each four-cell block

requirements: the exact pair03 target/reference center positions reflect across the robot sagittal plane
control and reflected scenes settle collision-free and neither requested relation is true at reset
LEFT and RIGHT fingerprints are identical within arm
required SAPIEN/Vulkan views and raw writers persist on the ali PVC
model_blind_gate.failure_rule: Any failed mirrored-scene feasibility row fails V3-B007 closed; do not substitute another scene after seeing behavior.

analysis_plan.primary: Per-seed reflected-minus-control interaction in signed endpoint redirection.
analysis_plan.secondary: Requested-side depth, binary success DiD, exact paired tests, and failure taxonomy.
analysis_plan.negative_control_interpretation: A null interaction would bound mirror sensitivity for this checkpoint and arena; it would not prove absence of geometry effects generally.
analysis_plan.arena_boundary: Never pool these RoboTwin outcomes with DROID.

release_boundary.next_action: Run the 27-seed-capable model-blind mirrored-scene feasibility gate, then bind the exact 108-row queue before inference.
